reconstructed_theorem_text:
For every natural number n with 3 ≤ n and every real number κ with 4 ≤ κ, work in E = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), with its genuine Euclidean l2 norm, and in the full real orthogonal group G = O(n), including both determinant signs, with the inherited matrix Borel structure. Let H be the literal measure Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts G), namely Haar probability normalized on the entire compact group. Put s = √κ, r = (1 − 1/n)((s − 1)/(s + 1)), and ℓ = (4ns + (s − 1)²)/(8n(n − 1)), where occurrences of n in these arithmetic formulas are real coercions. Let j₀ be the index 0 in Fin n. Define c : G → E by c(O) = WithLp.toLp 2 (i ↦ Oᵢⱼ₀), the Euclidean vector given by the zeroth column of O, and define ν to be exactly the pushforward H.map c.

For every y ∈ E write y₀ = WithLp.ofLp y j₀ and define the real-valued function f on the whole ambient Euclidean space by f(y) = ((s + 1)y₀ − (s − 1))/(1 + r² − 2ry₀)^(n/2). Here n/2 is a real exponent and this expression uses the standard totalized real division and real-power operations, including at ambient points where ordinary positive-base interpretations do not apply. For every O ∈ G let A(O) = ((κ + 1)/2) • I − ((κ − 1)/4) • (O + Oᵀ), let C(O) be its existing nonsingular matrix inverse A(O)⁻¹, and define γ(O) to be literally ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : E) C(O). This is the existing pushforward of canonical stdGaussian by the continuous linear map obtained from the existing totalized positive matrix square root of C(O), with the usual positive-semidefinite-domain meaning; no replacement measure is part of the statement.

Then all of the following hold together: ν is a probability measure; ‖y‖ = 1 for ν-almost every y ∈ E; for every Q ∈ G the pushforward of ν by y ↦ Matrix.toEuclideanCLM(Q)(y), that is ordinary multiplication Qy, equals ν; and f is absolutely Bochner L1 integrable with respect to ν. In addition, the following exact identity of real integrals holds:

∫[O ∈ G] det(O) (∫[x ∈ E] exp(−ℓ‖x‖²) dγ(O)(x)) dH(O)
= (((−1)^(n − 1) (s − 1)^(n − 1))/(s + 1)^n) (1 − 1/n)^(n/2) (∫[y ∈ E] f(y) dν(y)).

The outer integral is over the entire orthogonal group under H, and for each O the inner integral is over all E under γ(O). The final integral is over all E under the literal column pushforward ν. The exponents n − 1 in the sign and numerator powers use natural subtraction; n in (s + 1)^n is a natural exponent; n/2 in both real-power expressions is real. The norm in the Gaussian integral and in the almost-everywhere assertion is the Euclidean norm. The only independent parameters are n and κ with the stated bounds: s, r, ℓ, c, ν, f, and γ are the explicit dependent definitions above, H depends on n, and there are no unspecified constants or additional quantifiers over measures, functions, or parameters.

The almost-everywhere sphere assertion is not an assertion that every ambient y has unit norm. The probability, almost-everywhere support, and orthogonal pushforward invariance assertions do not state any additional identification of ν with a separately defined sphere or surface measure. Integrability is asserted for f under ν; no separate outer- or inner-integrability clause is stated. The theorem does not assert global positivity of the displayed denominator, global continuity of f, or an additional positive-definiteness conclusion about A(O) or C(O). It states the displayed exact integral relation and does not separately supply a value for either side or for the final integral.

semantic_slots.objects: E, full real orthogonal G, normalized compact-group Haar measure H, s, r, ℓ, j₀, literal zeroth-column map c, ν = H.map c, ambient totalized function f, A(O), C(O) = A(O)⁻¹, and the existing Gaussian constructor γ(O).
semantic_slots.domains: n ∈ ℕ; κ ∈ ℝ; O,Q ∈ full O(n); x,y ∈ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n); coordinates indexed by Fin n; all measures have the displayed domains.
semantic_slots.quantifiers: Universally for every n ≥ 3 and κ ≥ 4; all subsequent objects are let-defined. The support assertion is ν-almost everywhere, invariance is for every Q ∈ G, and the integrals bind O, x, and y over their full displayed spaces.
semantic_slots.assumptions: Only 3 ≤ n and 4 ≤ κ, in addition to the parameter types and approved meanings of the existing constructors.
semantic_slots.conclusion: Conjunction of probability of ν, ν-almost-everywhere Euclidean unit norm, invariance of the literal measure under every orthogonal matrix action, absolute Bochner L1 integrability of f under ν, and the displayed exact determinant-weighted Gaussian integral identity.
semantic_slots.scopes: Full O(n), not a determinant-sign component; Euclidean l2 norm; literal measure pushforwards; real-coerced dimension arithmetic; natural subtraction in n − 1 exponents; real n/2 powers; totalized division, real powers, square root constructor, and existing matrix inverse. No extra sphere-measure identification, global denominator positivity or continuity, positive-definiteness conclusion, separate inner/outer integrability assertion, or independent integral evaluation is stated.
semantic_slots.constant_dependencies: No unspecified constants. H and the underlying spaces depend on n; all scalar and measure/function definitions are explicitly determined by n and κ (with γ additionally evaluated at O).
